chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil (may God be pleased with him) narrated to me, saying: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-At'tar narrated to me, saying: Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Obayd narrated to me, from Ahmad ibn Abdullah, who said: I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him),

about Thul-Faqar, the sword of the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family), asking: 'From where is it?' He (peace be upon him) replied: 'Gabriel (peace be upon him) brought it down from the heaven. It had a silver adornment/coating, and it is with me.'

key_terms.سَيْفِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: Sword of the Messenger of God

ai.seo_question: What is the origin and current location of Thul-Faqar according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, Imam al-Rida (a.s.) confirms the celestial origin of Thul-Faqar, stating it was descended by Gabriel (a.s.) and adorned with silver, residing with him as a sign of his Imamate. This tradition highlights the continuity of prophetic relics within the Ahl al-Bayt, reinforcing the spiritual authority of the Imams in Shia tradition. The mention of silver adornment may allude to the unique craftsmanship or divine blessing associated with the sword, distinguishing it from ordinary weapons.
